title: Under-14 passenger and Hungarian student ID

turns.user: My child is 13. Do I have to buy an airport shuttle ticket?
turns.agent:
If you mean the 100E Airport Express: I can’t determine from “13” alone whether your child may travel free. The 5 November 2026 snapshot notes documented age-based free-travel entitlements, but doesn’t specify the exact age rule or the proof/conditions needed. Please check BKK’s current airport shuttle ticket information before travelling; I don’t want to guess and risk giving you the wrong advice.

For context, the snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. Ordinary single tickets and a regular Budapest travelcard/pass do not by themselves cover 100E. If you mean 200E, it follows ordinary ticket/pass rules, so the answer is different. Is your child taking 100E or 200E?

turns.user: They have a valid Hungarian student ID. We're taking 100E.
turns.agent:
Thanks—that clarifies you’re taking 100E. I still can’t confirm from the snapshot whether a 13-year-old rides it free, or what proof is required. A Hungarian student ID doesn’t by itself settle the 100E age-based free-travel rule; the student-pass information in my snapshot concerns higher-education passes, not this child’s airport-trip eligibility.

So I wouldn’t assume the 100E ticket can be skipped based on the student ID alone. The 5 November 2026 snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF, but notes age-based free-travel entitlements without specifying their exact ages or conditions. Please confirm the current rule and required proof in BKK’s Airport shuttle bus single ticket information before travelling; I can’t verify eligibility or issue a ticket.
